title.narrative: Support to effective food security, nutrition and resilience programming in Ethiopia

description.narrative: The project action aims to build upon the achievements of the previous project Support the Government of Ethiopia to enhance food security information, national social protection and disaster risk management systems. It specifically focus on food security analysis using the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC), disaster risk management in agriculture, and Productive Safety Net Programme (PSNP) livelihoods interventions.
